claims.text: The PMO release states: 'In accordance with Clause 50A of the Constitution of Tonga, His Majesty King Tupou VI has appointed the Prime Minister-Designate, Honourable Samuela 'Akilisi Pohiva, as the Prime Minister of Tonga, with effect from 2 January, 2018.'
claims.locator: Body paragraph 1; issued by the Prime Minister's Office
claims.uncertainty: The effective date is stated. The release carries the dateline '04th January, 2017', a misprint beside the page date of Thursday 04 January 2018. The signature or presentation date of the warrant is not given. The same release says he 'served as the 16th Prime Minister from 2015-2017' and 'will serve his second term in office from 2018-2021, as the 17th Prime Minister'; these spans and ordinals are recorded as printed and are not used as boundaries: they neither end his 2014 appointment in 2017 nor define a term.
